goal: balances replays postings and retractions in arrival order. Event IDs are globally idempotent. Unlike deferred cancellation, a retraction whose posting has not arrived is ignored permanently and must not consume the posting cancellation. A later distinct retraction may cancel that posting once. Accounts retain zero entries. Inspect source, repair the implementation, and run the tests. Do not modify tests.
